set.name: Rosie's Loadout: The Hunger in the Bog

cards.name: Rosie, Heart of the Herd
cards.text: Once each turn after you equip Gear, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: Every grand adventure begins with a very small oink.

cards.name: Copper, Trailblazer
cards.text: The first Critter you attack with each Battle gets +1 Bash.
cards.flavor: Copper calls it a shortcut once everyone catches up.

cards.name: Pepper, Night Watch
cards.text: The first time a ready Critter protects you each turn, prevent 1 additional damage.
cards.flavor: Pepper notices the trouble several minutes before trouble does.

cards.name: Bandit, Quick Hoof
cards.text: Once each turn after you play a Stunt, your Held Gear gets +1 Bash for its next attack.
cards.flavor: Nothing is stolen. Several things are merely relocated.

cards.name: Pickles, Orchard Finder
cards.text: At the start of your turn, look at the top card of your deck; you may put it on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Pickles has never met a patch that was finished hiding.

cards.name: Biscuit, Stouthearted
cards.text: The first time your Head prevents damage each turn, restore 1 Cheer.
cards.flavor: Biscuit packs courage, snacks, and then more snacks.

cards.name: Ticket Taker's Cap
cards.text: When equipped, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: Rosie kept the ticket. Ate the stub.

training.name: Keep Order
training.text: One Critter may attack this Battle without exhausting.

cards.name: Muddy Cap
cards.text: After this prevents damage, your next Critter attack gets +1 Bash.
cards.flavor: Already dirty. Completely fearless.

training.name: Sling Back
training.text: Your next attack this turn gets +1 Bash.

cards.name: Mushroom Cap
cards.text: When equipped, look at the top two cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: A suspiciously comfortable bit of forest.

training.name: Spore Peek
training.text: Look at the top card; you may put it on the bottom.

cards.name: Bog Helmet
cards.text: The first time this readies each turn, prevent 1 damage to a Critter.
cards.flavor: Mud-tested. Pig-approved.

training.name: Hunker Down
training.text: Until your next turn, prevent the first 1 damage to your Legend.

cards.name: Reed Hat
cards.text: Ready this after you replace your Aura.
cards.flavor: The marsh made it. Rosie added the jaunty angle.

training.name: Reweave
training.text: Return one Aura you control to your hand.

cards.name: Slop Bucket Hat
cards.text: When this prevents damage, deal 1 damage to the attacking Enemy.
cards.flavor: Protection, percussion, and lunch service.

training.name: Bucket Bonk
training.text: Deal 1 damage to an Enemy.

cards.name: Release Party Crown
cards.text: When equipped with a full loadout, restore 2 Cheer and draw a card.
cards.flavor: Worn once. Bragged about forever.

training.name: Grand Entrance
training.text: Play a rank 1 Gear from your discard.

cards.name: Swamp Crown
cards.text: Your ready Steady Critter prevents one additional damage.
cards.flavor: The bog votes unanimously. The frogs abstain.

training.name: Hold the Bog
training.text: One ready Critter prevents one additional damage until your next turn.

cards.name: The Hungerer's Crown
cards.text: After this prevents damage from an Enemy, your Legend's next attack gets +2 Bash.
cards.flavor: Dented, tarnished, and indisputably earned.

training.name: Claim the Hoard
training.text: Draw a card after you defeat an Enemy this turn.

cards.name: Toy Sword
cards.text: This gets +1 Bash when attacking a Critter or Enemy.
cards.flavor: Foam blade. Real battle face.

training.name: Big Wind-Up
training.text: Your Legend's next attack gets +1 Bash.

cards.name: Slop Bucket
cards.text: After this attacks, you may ready one Steady Critter that did not attack.
cards.flavor: Heavy enough to matter. Sloshy enough to regret.

training.name: Pass It Down
training.text: Ready a Critter; it cannot attack this Battle.

cards.name: Firefly Lantern
cards.text: After this attacks, look at the top card of your deck.
cards.flavor: Three fireflies inside, working in shifts.

training.name: Lantern Signal
training.text: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Mud Shovel
cards.text: On a hit to a Legend, look at the top two cards; reveal and draw one Gear.
cards.flavor: One scoop for the bog. One for trouble.

training.name: Root Around
training.text: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Magic Wand
cards.text: Once each Battle, you may give this attack −1 Bash to draw a card.
cards.flavor: Mostly sparkles. The rest is confidential.

training.name: Tiny Miracle
training.text: Your next Stunt this turn may be rank 1 higher than your level.

cards.name: Crew Pennant
cards.text: Your first Critter attack each Battle gets +1 Bash.
cards.flavor: The whole Sounder fits on one very loud flag.

training.name: Rally the Sounder
training.text: One Critter gets +1 Bash this Battle.

cards.name: Golden Truffle
cards.text: The first time this damages a Legend each turn, restore 1 Cheer.
cards.flavor: Too precious to eat. Rosie is considering it.

training.name: Gilded Find
training.text: Restore 2 Cheer.

cards.name: Golden Hog Cup
cards.text: After your Legend defeats a Critter or Enemy, ready one Critter.
cards.flavor: Polished for champions. Already full of fingerprints.

training.name: Victory Lap
training.text: A Critter may attack twice this Battle; its second attack gets −1 Bash.

cards.name: Mud Pie
cards.text: Instead of attacking, exhaust this to prevent the next 3 damage to your Legend.
cards.flavor: Not dessert. This has not stopped anyone.

training.name: Save a Slice
training.text: Until your next turn, prevent the first 2 damage to your Legend.

cards.name: Firefly Aura
cards.text: After the first Stunt you play each turn, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: Every firefly volunteered. Allegedly.

training.name: Glimmer
training.text: Look at the top card; you may put it on the bottom.

cards.name: Mud Splatter Aura
cards.text: After your Legend attacks, deal 1 damage to a different Enemy.
cards.flavor: Clean lines are for pigs who stayed home.

training.name: Follow-Through
training.text: Deal 1 damage to an exhausted Enemy.

cards.name: Swamp Bubble Aura
cards.text: The first time a Critter would be defeated each turn, it survives with 1 Heart.
cards.flavor: The bubbles smell heroic from a respectful distance.

training.name: Bubble Up
training.text: Prevent the next 1 damage to a Critter.

cards.name: Shadow Aura
cards.text: Your Legend's first attack each turn ignores one ready Critter.
cards.flavor: Rosie insists the shadow moved first.

training.name: Slip Past
training.text: One opposing Critter does not protect this turn.

cards.name: Confetti Aura
cards.text: When you complete your loadout, draw two cards, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: The celebration began before anyone found the invitation.

training.name: Surprise Party
training.text: Play a rank 1 Stunt from your discard.

cards.name: Holy Aura
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if both Critters are ready, restore 1 Cheer.
cards.flavor: Warm enough to make even the mud behave.

training.name: Soft Light
training.text: Restore 1 Cheer if you control a ready Critter.

cards.name: Golden Bog Aura
cards.text: With a full loadout, your Held gets +1 Bash and your Head gets +1 Guard.
cards.flavor: The bog cleaned itself up for this.

training.name: Perfect Balance
training.text: The first Gear you exhaust before your next turn readies after use; its next use gets −1.

cards.name: Heirloom Mire Aura
cards.text: Each time one of your Gear cards is discarded from play, your next attack gets +1 Bash.
cards.flavor: Passed down through generations of extremely muddy pigs.

training.name: Old Mud, New Trick
training.text: Return a Gear from your discard to the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Chorus Glow
cards.text: Once each turn when a Critter readies, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: The song is mostly oinks. The harmony is impeccable.

training.name: Join the Chorus
training.text: Ready one Critter; it cannot attack this Battle.

cards.name: Firefly Swarm
cards.text: When played, look at the top card; you may put it on the bottom.
cards.flavor: They disagree on direction and agree on enthusiasm.

training.name: Little Lights
training.text: Look at the top card of your deck.

cards.name: Dewdrop Spider
cards.text: This prevents one additional damage while you control an Aura.
cards.flavor: Her web catches dew, crumbs, and occasional applause.

training.name: Silken Brace
training.text: Prevent the next 1 damage to a Critter.

cards.name: Trough Sparrow
cards.text: When this attacks an Enemy, it gets +1 Bash.
cards.flavor: Small bird. Large opinions about breakfast.

training.name: Sharp Chirp
training.text: A Critter gets +1 Bash against an Enemy this Battle.

cards.name: Bumblebee
cards.text: After this attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: Every route is the scenic route.

training.name: Busy Loop
training.text: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Puddle Duckling
cards.text: When played, prevent the next 1 damage to your Legend.
cards.flavor: Follows Rosie everywhere except somewhere dry.

training.name: Waddle In
training.text: Prevent the next 1 damage to your Legend.

cards.name: Garden Snail
cards.text: This may attack the turn it is played.
cards.flavor: Fast is a state of mind.

training.name: Surprising Speed
training.text: One newly played Critter may attack this Battle.

cards.name: Lantern Rabbit
cards.text: When played, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: Always two hops ahead of the light.

training.name: Pathfinder
training.text: Look at the top two cards; put them back in any order.

cards.name: Bog Frog
cards.text: This prevents one additional damage while ready.
cards.flavor: Round, resolute, and sitting exactly where you need to step.

training.name: Hunker
training.text: Until your next turn, prevent the first 1 damage to a Critter.

cards.name: Truffle Mole
cards.text: On a hit, look at the top two cards; reveal and draw one Gear.
cards.flavor: Can smell treasure. Cannot define restraint.

training.name: Dig
training.text: Reveal the top card; draw it if it is Gear.

cards.name: Waltzing Moth
cards.text: After you play a Stunt, ready this. It cannot attack again this Battle.
cards.flavor: Every lantern is a ballroom if you believe hard enough.

training.name: Moth Waltz
training.text: Ready a Spark Critter; it cannot attack this Battle.

cards.name: Shy Field Mouse
cards.text: The first time this protects your Legend each turn, restore 1 Cheer.
cards.flavor: Mostly hiding. Entirely helpful.

training.name: Quiet Comfort
training.text: Restore 1 Cheer if you control a ready Critter.

cards.name: Acorn Squirrel
cards.text: After this defeats an Enemy, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Prepared for winter, spring, and several imaginary emergencies.

training.name: Stockpile
training.text: Put a card from your discard on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Moon Firefly
cards.text: Your first Spark Training action each turn may be used twice.
cards.flavor: Carries one pocket-sized piece of moonlight.

training.name: Moon Signal
training.text: Play a rank 1 Spark Stunt from your discard.

cards.name: Coquí Critter
cards.text: At end of turn, restore 1 Cheer if this stayed ready.
cards.flavor: Two notes, repeated perfectly, all night.

training.name: Night Song
training.text: One Critter may attack without exhausting this Battle.

cards.name: Mud Crab
cards.text: After this attacks, it may move 1 damage from itself to an Enemy it attacked.
cards.flavor: Approaches every problem from the correct sideways angle.

training.name: Sideways Charge
training.text: Move 1 damage from a Critter to an Enemy.

cards.name: Glowworm Choir
cards.text: When played, each player draws a card; you may then discard a card to draw another.
cards.flavor: They know one song. It happens to be excellent.

training.name: Refrain
training.text: Draw a card, then put a card from hand on top of your deck.

cards.name: Field Mouse Family
cards.text: This counts as two ready Critters when preventing damage, but occupies both Critter spaces.
cards.flavor: Nobody remembers inviting all seven. Nobody minds.

training.name: Make Room
training.text: Your ready Critters prevent one additional damage from the next hit.

cards.name: Robin Lookout
cards.text: Before this attacks, look at the opponent's hand; choose no cards.
cards.flavor: The warning is useful. The commentary is optional.

training.name: Sound the Call
training.text: Your first Critter attack this Battle gets +2 Bash.

cards.name: Goblin Scout
cards.text: When played, it attacks immediately, then exhausts.
cards.flavor: Sneaking would work better without the tiny war drum.

training.name: Scout Ahead
training.text: Look at the top card of an opponent's deck.

cards.name: Peeking Hungerling
cards.text: When defeated, the defeating player draws a card.
cards.flavor: Absolutely not hiding anything behind its back.

training.name: Hide the Truffle
training.text: Put a card from your discard on top of your deck.

cards.name: Mud-Slick Spider
cards.text: Critters attacking this get −1 Bash.
cards.flavor: Eight boots. Not one of them clean.

training.name: Sticky Thread
training.text: One Enemy gets −1 Bash until your next turn.

cards.name: Truffle-Thief Crow
cards.text: When this damages a Legend, that player discards, then draws a card.
cards.flavor: Returns shiny things. Truffles are apparently exempt.

training.name: Snatch
training.text: An opponent puts a random card from hand on the bottom of their deck, then draws.

cards.name: Goblin Grunt
cards.text: This gets +1 Bash while another Goblin is in Trouble.
cards.flavor: Very brave in groups of at least two.

training.name: Pile On
training.text: An Enemy gets +1 Bash until your next turn.

cards.name: Cheek-Stuffed Hungerling
cards.text: The first damage dealt to this each turn is prevented.
cards.flavor: Saving that truffle for much, much later.

training.name: Full Cheeks
training.text: Prevent the next 1 damage to an Enemy.

cards.name: Bog Bubble
cards.text: When defeated, return it to its owner's hand unless a Stunt damaged it this turn.
cards.flavor: Every pop reveals a smaller, ruder bubble.

training.name: Pop Back
training.text: Return a rank 1 card from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Root Tangle
cards.text: The afflicted Legend's Held Gear gets −1 Bash.
cards.flavor: Not lost. Merely held in place by the forest.

training.name: Dig In
training.text: One Held Gear gets −1 Bash until your next turn.

cards.name: Goblin Brute
cards.text: When this attacks, exhaust one Critter that protected the Legend.
cards.flavor: Subtlety surrendered before the first stomp.

training.name: Big Stomp
training.text: Exhaust a damaged Critter.

cards.name: Scurrying Hungerling
cards.text: After this attacks, move it to the other Trouble space if possible. It stays exhausted.
cards.flavor: Fast paws. Faster appetite.

training.name: Scurry
training.text: Return an Enemy to its owner's hand; its owner discards a card.

cards.name: Goblin Warboss
cards.text: Other Goblins in Trouble get +1 Bash and +1 Heart.
cards.flavor: The helmet is doing most of the leadership.

training.name: Boss Around
training.text: Ready one Enemy; it gets −1 Bash for its next attack.

cards.name: The Great Hungerer
cards.text: Occupies both Trouble spaces. When damaged, its owner may discard a card to prevent 1 of that damage.
cards.flavor: He did not want everything. He simply never learned what enough felt like.

training.name: Endless Appetite
training.text: Draw two cards, then discard two cards.

cards.name: Big Wind-Up
cards.text: Your Legend's next attack this turn gets +2 Bash.
cards.flavor: Three circles for momentum. One for dramatic effect.

training.name: Wind Up
training.text: Your Legend's next attack gets +1 Bash.

cards.name: Duck Into the Mud
cards.text: Before your next turn, prevent the next 2 damage to your Legend.
cards.flavor: The cleanest escape route was never considered.

training.name: Mud Cover
training.text: Restore 1 Cheer.

cards.name: Quick Change
cards.text: Replace one equipped card with a same-slot Gear from your hand.
cards.flavor: Behind the curtain: one pig, six outfits, no explanation.

training.name: Pocket Swap
training.text: Return one equipped Gear to your hand.

cards.name: Warm Tea
cards.text: Restore 2 Cheer. If your Legend is level 3 or higher, restore 3 instead.
cards.flavor: A cup, a saucer, and five quiet minutes.

training.name: Steep
training.text: Restore 1 Cheer.

cards.name: Sun Beam
cards.text: Ready one Aura or Spark Critter. It cannot attack this Battle.
cards.flavor: The sun found the one warm plank in the whole barn.

training.name: Bright Spot
training.text: Look at the top two cards; put them back in any order.

cards.name: Root Around
cards.text: Look at the top three cards; reveal and draw a Gear or Critter.
cards.flavor: The useful thing is always beneath the less useful thing.

training.name: Good Sniff
training.text: Look at the top two cards; reveal and draw one Gear.

cards.name: Firefly Feint
cards.text: One opposing Critter does not protect this turn.
cards.flavor: Everyone watched the light. Nobody watched Rosie.

training.name: Distract
training.text: One opposing Critter protects for one less this turn.

cards.name: Halo Kiss
cards.text: Restore 1 Cheer, then a Critter gets +2 Bash this Battle.
cards.flavor: Courage, delivered directly to the snoot.

training.name: Blessed Charge
training.text: A Critter gets +1 Bash this Battle.

cards.name: Mud Wrap
cards.text: Ready your Head. It gets +1 Guard for its next use.
cards.flavor: Half spa treatment, half structural reinforcement.

training.name: Warm Wrap
training.text: Your Head gets +1 Guard for its next use.

cards.name: Goblin Whisper
cards.text: Move one Enemy to an open Trouble space. It attacks immediately with −1 Bash.
cards.flavor: The whisper was mostly giggling and one terrible suggestion.

training.name: Bad Advice
training.text: An Enemy gets +1 Bash for its next attack.

cards.name: Encore!
cards.text: Your Legend may attack twice this Battle; the second attack gets −1 Bash.
cards.flavor: The audience requested another. Rosie counted herself twice.

training.name: Again!
training.text: A Critter may attack twice this Battle; its second attack gets −1 Bash.

cards.name: Glimmer Truffle
cards.text: Draw two cards. You may play one rank 1 Gear among them immediately.
cards.flavor: Not quite gold. More than shiny enough.

training.name: Glimmer
training.text: Draw a card.

cards.name: Snoot Boop
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an Enemy, then restore 2 Cheer.
cards.flavor: One precise tap. Universal barnyard diplomacy.

training.name: Boop
training.text: Deal 1 damage to an Enemy.

cards.name: Phantom Itch
cards.text: Choose an opposing Head, Held, or Critter. It does not ready during its controller's next Ready step.
cards.flavor: Always one inch farther left than the last scratch.

training.name: Just There
training.text: Exhaust one rank 1 card.

cards.name: Chorus Glow
cards.text: Ready both Critters. Until your next turn, each prevents one additional damage.
cards.flavor: The whole Sounder found the note at exactly the same time.

training.name: Sing Together
training.text: Ready one Critter; it cannot attack this Battle.

cards.name: Homestead Barn
cards.text: The first Critter you play each turn enters ready even if an effect says otherwise.
cards.flavor: Every trail eventually remembers the way home.

training.name: Home Ground
training.text: Restore 1 Cheer if your Trouble row is empty.

cards.name: Truffle Patch
cards.text: After your Legend damages an Enemy, look at the top card; draw it if it is Gear.
cards.flavor: Two truffles buried. Several pigs already arguing over where.

training.name: Fresh Dig
training.text: Deal 1 damage to an Enemy.

cards.name: Reed Marsh
cards.text: Once each turn after you return a card to hand, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.flavor: The straight path is underwater and therefore unofficial.

training.name: Marsh Path
training.text: Return a rank 1 Critter you control to your hand.

cards.name: Mud Derby
cards.text: The first Critter to attack each Battle gets +1 Bash and does not protect this turn.
cards.flavor: Rules are posted somewhere beneath the mud.

training.name: Starting Bell
training.text: Your first attack this Battle gets +1 Bash.

cards.name: Festival Night
cards.text: The first Stunt each player plays on their turn may be rank 1 higher than their Legend's level.
cards.flavor: Every lantern lit. Every pig pretending bedtime was canceled.

training.name: Lantern Hour
training.text: Play a rank 1 Spark card from your discard.

cards.name: Golden Mire
cards.text: At end of turn, if you have a full loadout and two ready Critters, restore 2 Cheer.
cards.flavor: The mud gleams like treasure and sticks like ordinary mud.

training.name: Golden Footing
training.text: Your Head gets +1 Guard and Held gets +1 Bash for their next uses.

cards.name: Porch Fireflies
cards.text: When this readies, look at the top card of your deck; you may put it on the bottom.
cards.flavor: They blink twice for company and three times for snacks.

training.name: Porch Signal
training.text: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Wallow Gremlin
cards.text: When this attacks, one ready Critter cannot protect against this attack.
cards.flavor: It heard the spa included mud and ignored every other word.

training.name: Mud Rush
training.text: An Enemy gets +1 Bash for its next attack.

cards.name: Golden Wave
cards.text: Ready a Critter. It cannot attack this Battle. Restore 1 Cheer.
cards.flavor: A proper farewell uses the whole hoof.

training.name: Kind Return
training.text: Prevent the next 1 damage to a Critter.

cards.name: Spa Wallow
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if your Legend did not attack, ready one Gear.
cards.flavor: Five quiet minutes, followed by one magnificent splash.

training.name: Deep Soak
training.text: Restore 2 Cheer if your Legend did not attack this turn.
